column7: A grant of an ADR-021 project-tier role (project_admin/developer/viewer/auditor, exact names) with no project_id was written at the global scope and applied in EVERY project (DEMO-WALK-4: the web UI group Manage Roles posted no project_id; alice got project_developer everywhere). Same gap on user grants, CreateUser/InviteGlobal system_role, SSO default_role/group_role_map, and {project 0, environment X} scopes. Fixed in internal/core (role_scope_guard.go) at every grant write; completeness: TestEveryRoleGrantWriteChecksRoleScope (AST over every storage grant-writer call). HTTP 400 / gRPC InvalidArgument. Red on main.
